question: Among191 observed CNS trials including8 half-duration predictors and8 full accepted epochs, how many step endpoints are prescribed event cuts versus epoch ends, and how small is error on noncut trials?
interpretation: Classification is retrospective on a read-only instrumented run. If many trial ends are events and accepted errors tiny, do not claim stiffness from limiting row. A change to next-step policy needs a new prospective parity/error/event experiment.
